title: FactorMAD: A Multi-Agent Debate Framework Based on Large Language Models for Interpretable Stock Alpha Factor Mining

claim.summary: FactorMAD alternates two differently initialized LLM debaters to propose alpha-factor code, repairs invalid implementations and retains factors based on predictive quality and diversity.

modules.name: Perspective-diverse alpha-factor debate
modules.scope_reason: Agents derive perspectives from existing factor code/performance and critique candidate alpha factors against a return-prediction objective.
evidence_locators: PDF p.3; passage beginning "3.2 Agent Debate Framework"

modules.name: Alpha-factor implementation and diversity validation
modules.scope_reason: Validation enforces factor-specific output and cross-sectional comparability; IC/ICIR and factor correlation decide library admission.

modules.name: Past-only rolling-window constraint
modules.scope_reason: Future-timestamp exclusion and replacing full-series statistics with rolling operations express temporal availability independent of the financial objective.
